title: When AI Classifies: What Counts as Public Administration?
abstract: arXiv:2607.05420v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This study examines how alternative systems of scholarly representation identify and characterize public administration (PA) and artificial intelligence-related PA (AI-in-PA) scholarship. The central question is not which system provides a definitive classification of PA, but how alternative systems of scholarly classification differ in identifying and representing its intellectual boundaries. With an exploratory and comparative analysis of Web of Science and OpenAlex, the study compares five approaches based on author-defined, citation-driven, and AI-assisted representations. The results highlight substantial differences and limited overlap in corpus size, publication type, DOI availability, publishing outlets, temporal patterns, and thematic structure. The alternative approaches tend to produce distinct representations because they identify substantially different bodies of scholarship rather than merely larger or smaller sub

translated_title: 当人工智能进行分类时：什么才算公共行政学？
translated_abstract: 本研究考察了不同的学术表征系统如何识别与界定公共行政（PA）以及人工智能相关的公共行政（AI-in-PA）学术研究。其核心问题并非哪一个系统能为公共行政提供权威的分类，而是不同的学术分类系统在识别和表征其知识边界时有何差异。通过对 Web of Science 和 OpenAlex 的探索性与比较性分析，本研究比较了基于作者自定义、引文驱动和人工智能辅助表征的五种方法。结果显示，在语料库规模、出版物类型、DOI 可用性、发表渠道、时间模式以及主题结构等方面存在显著差异且重叠有限。这些不同的方法往往会产生截然不同的学术表征，因为它们识别出的研究集合在本质上并不相同，而不仅仅是更大或更小的子集。
tldr: 本研究通过对比 Web of Science 与 OpenAlex 中基于作者自定义、引文驱动和人工智能辅助的五类分类方法，揭示了不同学术表征系统在界定公共行政（尤其是AI相关研究）的知识边界时存在显著差异且重叠有限。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that five classification approaches (author-defined, citation-driven, and AI-assisted) across Web of Science and OpenAlex produce substantially different and minimally overlapping representations of the intellectual boundaries of public administration and AI-related PA scholarship.
